features.currentImplementationNote: NAV training boxes and §1.21 Bearing True/Mag, Wind True/Apparent and Own/NMEA Trip/Temp/Speed Source selectors now have staged, persisted, replayable state; typed Own position/waypoint/speed projects TIME TO GO (SIM EST), with missing destination, stale/invalid position, negative/zero speed or unavailable NMEA => NO DATA. Course is angular-bounded; independent bearing/heading/SOG/pressure/XTE require explicit per-field synthetic provenance and bounded values, without inventing real ship observations. OEM ETA, Data Box and complete source availability remain partial

features.currentImplementationNote: Optional Tankenmaru is SOURCE_GAP/HOLD by default on unknown hardware. An explicitly enabled D15 virtual option permits On/Off and a read-only §2.9 reference panel for Output Off, Pic. Sync Yes and Sub Clutter 4, documented as manual defaults only. Virtual On suppresses NMEA setup in both System and Installation, and Off restores it; revocation restores MARK/NMEA. No editable OEM submenu/range, output, RF transport or partner display; real hardware/firmware behavior remains unimplemented
features.missingIndependentEvidence: Documented installed Tankenmaru option, actual hardware settings/output and partner display; no RF or actual interface assumed

features.currentImplementationNote: NMEA physical port remains Off; read-only status modal projects D15 synthetic fixture missing/fresh/stale with hemisphere-safe coordinates and rejects impossible/out-of-range fixes. Own Trip/Speed/Temperature availability requires a valid fresh typed synthetic position; negative Own speed and NMEA-selected speed cannot leak from internal sample, and Tankenmaru On suppresses receiver data. No real IEC/NMEA electrical port or vessel transport exists.
features.missingIndependentEvidence: Independent real-port and NMEA sentence source evidence, installed device firmware/port setup and qualified safety review; virtual ownship fixture not hardware
